headline: Pickle ball court proposal for Slater Park, plus updates on John St. and Thomas Duffy playgrounds.
summary: The meeting covers a proposed pickle ball court location at Slater Park. It also includes updates on the John St. playground, the Thomas Duffy playground and courts, and parks and tree work.
